tests: engines/usul/tests/test_p0_bridge.py (18 cases: 11-case negative table + invariants + integration)
demo: engines/usul/examples/p0-bridge-demo-{bundle,specs,facts}.json — offline deterministic replay via: python -m engines.usul.p0_bridge <bundle> <specs> <facts>
now_executable: deduction rules with formalization_status=machine_checkable AND an explicit bounded propositional spec (if_all/unless_any/then)
fact assertions backed by evidence that exists in the P0 bundle and is verified
objection propagation: open/sustained objections on a target inference block its executable rules (BLOCKED_BY_OBJECTION)
deterministic one-step evaluation with full trace: missing premises, unresolved exceptions/objections, rule and premise evidence chains
conflict detection: two rules reaching opposite conclusions on the same atom yield CONTESTED
methodology isolation: rules spanning multiple methodologies refuse the derivation until a reconciliation contract exists
still_structural_only: Rule.expression free text: never parsed or executed (verified by hostile-expression test producing identical output)
constraint and exception rule types: carried as P0 representation, no executor semantics
rules with formalization_status=draft or without a propositional spec: REPRESENTATION_ONLY_NO_EXECUTABLE_SPEC
qiyas and tarjih: REJECTED_UNSUPPORTED_RULE_KIND - no formal semantics defined, no approximate analogy permitted
multi-step rule chaining: U0.1 stays one-step; conclusion-as-premise cycles are refused (DERIVATION_CYCLE)
cross-methodology reconciliation: refused (METHODOLOGY_MIXING_REFUSED) until an audited contract is defined
source authentication of evidence IDs: the bridge checks existence and verified status inside the bundle; external world verification stays outside its scope
invariants_held: scholarly_verified=false and valid_juristic_ruling=false and public_fatwa_authorized=false on every output
test proving a correct engineering simulation is never classified as an approved fiqh ruling
